should publish native four-sample typed images and resolves across partial edge tiles
should retain native publication ownership after shader leases retire and recover after cancellation
should share disjoint virtual physical and legacy DMA namespaces while retaining a stalled physical reply
should translate virtual reads reject read-only DMA writes and bypass translation for trusted physical images
should retain distinct descriptor bin state image and DMA IDs through reordered replies and simultaneous held outputs
should translate descriptors bins and both state readers enforce write permissions and bypass both physical image ranges
should decode fixed native layouts with out of order replies and retain complete pass draw and publication ownership
should reject malformed bounds encodings and capacity adaptation before issuing invalid child work
should drain held descriptor offers child controls and physical publication after cancellation or memory faults
should read each native record through the highest physical bytes with a four GiB exclusive limit
should use distinct record magic values without reusing legacy bin typed-image or fragment-state ABI identifiers
should snapshot three canonical records through four reordered tags and preserve fixed-capacity fields at the four GiB boundary
should reject malformed envelopes capacities padding bounds and writable descriptor aliases before exposing invalid work
should retain descriptor memory and nested child faults through cancellation drain and exact healthy reuse
should retain offered memory begin draw end and child publication ownership across cancellation

abi.unpublished_prototype_replaced: GNJ1/GNF1/GND1 replace the draft GBJ1/GBF1/GBD1 values to avoid the existing legacy GBJ1 job magic. Legacy bin, GTJ1/GTI1/GTD1 and GFS1 ABIs are unchanged; a regression checks disjoint magic sets.

ownership: Snapshot all payload contexts at native submit before descriptor fetch; retain them while raw inputs change
One actual vertex phase prepares ordered bin records; replay launches only fragment work
Native descriptor IDs0..3 and root IDs beginning16 are disjoint; per-engine image-local8..15 is physical while state-local16..19 stays virtual
Native completion retains descriptor reads, image owners, per-engine primitive/pixel/tile outputs, shader leases, queued memory and final physical acknowledgements

Standalone fabric translates descriptor/bin/state/staging and DMA, bypasses both image ranges, and buffers immutable virtual/physical/DMA replies through stalls; accepted lifetime ends only at producer response consumption
limitations: Real-shader owner tests use the shared GpuSystem in Bare mode. Sv32 fabric tests are standalone; owner-to-fabric production host/MMIO/reset composition is still pending
Trusted physical image allocation provenance and translated cross-resource alias validation remain enclosing responsibilities; numeric admission checks do not establish physical provenance
Runtime uses small capacities/images; the default full Mobile hierarchy is emitted but not full-runtime/rate/budget qualified
The new owner/fabric has no synthesis PPA result. The separately running replay-engine decoder synthesis must finish before timing conclusions
No place-and-route, power, CPU coherence or GLES conformance claim; all H0-H8 remain open
